description:

• Thoracic mobility, band pull-aparts, light hinge warm-up

3. Chest-Supported Barbell / T-Bar Row (3 sets x 8–10 reps): 50–60 kg
4. Incline Dumbbell Bench Press (3 sets x 8–10 reps): 22–26 kg DBs
5. Heavy Dumbbell Farmer's Walk / Sandbag Hold (3 sets x 45s): 2x26–30 kg DBs
6. Biceps Curls + Cable Lateral Raises (3 sets x 12 reps)

⏱️ Rest: 2–3 min on Deadlift/Push Press; 60–90s on accessories.

summary: 🏋️ ATHX 2027: Gym Session A (Squat, Quads & Lower Body MEV)
description:

5. Standing Calf Raises + Hanging Knee/Leg Raises (3 sets x 15 reps)

⏱️ Rest: 2–3 min on Back Squat; 60–90s on accessories.
